summary.intent: Improve readability and clarity of the injection and history tabs in the memorylooptui TUI, and understand how the memory injection system works.
summary.outcome: Injection tab spacing was improved, prompt preview storage limit was increased from 120 to 500 chars, and the history tab gained a descriptive header and wider scope column. The user also gained clarity on how PromptPreview is display-only and doesn't affect injection matching.

repo: PromptPreview in injection logs is truncated at storage time in lifecycle.go and is purely for TUI display — the full prompt is always used for actual memory matching via SelectRelevant()
The History tab tracks runs of `entire memory-loop refresh`, which uses an LLM to generate/reconcile/prune memories from recent session transcripts
memory-loop.json stores all injection logs; storing full prompts risks significant file bloat since prompts can be multi-KB with file contents and context

code.finding: truncatePromptPreview(event.Prompt, N) is called here at log-write time; limit was increased from 120 to 500 chars. Full prompt is used for matching before this truncation.
setSize caps table height at 10 and reserves 23 lines for other content; detail card gets the remainder. Prompt column truncation is set at 40 chars for table display.
Scope column widened from 8 to 16, scope value truncation from 6 to 12. setSize must be adjusted when header lines are added to the tab.

workflow: When a user complains about truncation in a detail view, check both the rendering layer and the data storage layer — truncation may happen at write time, not display time
Lipgloss handles word wrapping within card width automatically; explicit Width() on text elements is only needed for edge cases

friction: Misdiagnosis of where prompt truncation was happening — initially assumed it was a rendering/wrapping issue, required multiple grep passes to find the storage-time truncation in lifecycle.go
User had to clarify twice ('Im talking about prompt in injection detail card getting cut off') that they meant the detail card, not the table column
Widened prompt column to 70 then immediately reverted to 40 on user request — unnecessary churn
open_items: R key in the TUI is not yet wired up to trigger `entire memory-loop refresh` — noted as unimplemented during history tab explanation
No decision reached on whether 500 chars is the right long-term limit for PromptPreview storage, or if a higher limit (1000-2000) would be better
Full prompt storage was considered but deferred due to JSON bloat concerns — no alternative solution (e.g., separate prompt log file) was designed
